title: Construction/ Upgrading/ Rehabilitation of Drainage along National Roads, Urdaneta Jct-dagupan, Lingayen RD
description: CONSTRUCTION/ UPGRADING/ REHABILITATION OF DRAINAGE ALONG NATIONAL ROADS - SECONDARY ROADS, URDANETA JCT-DAGUPAN-LINGAYEN RD - K0208 + 234 - K0208 + 910
colour_meaning: Look first: an official warning record, or two signs of risk together.

items.label: One bidder
items.detail: 1 bidder(s) recorded. Not linked to failed contracts in past data, so not scored.

items.label: Price per km at or above the 95th percentile of similar works
items.detail: Official budget ₱97.7M per km over 676 m; 95% of 90 past Drainage along roads contracts cost less than ₱91.6M per km.

items.label: Regional cost factor
items.detail: Prices for similar works in Region I (Ilocos Region) run ×0.81 the national median; adjusted for the region: ₱120.7M per km vs national 95th percentile ₱91.6M.

items.label: A bidder had an earlier contract terminated
items.detail: Flordes Construction & Trading Corp. (winner): 4 of 130 earlier road contracts terminated

families.name: Contractor ownership, affiliation and bidding networks

items.label: Winner's other on-going roads
items.detail: Flordes Construction & Trading Corp. has 3 on-going DPWH road(s) possibly stalled and 0 far behind schedule (weekly stage-3 list; DPWH progress data can lag).

assessment.derivation: 1 strong + 1 weak signal(s) → High priority (2 strong, or 1 strong + 1 weak) → Red.

steps.title: Confirm the basic facts on the official DPWH page
sub: Budget, location, status, dates and bidders match this page.

steps.title: Find the bid documents
sub: Look for the quantities, a Bill of Quantities and technical specifications.
No link in DPWH's record: check PhilGEPS or ask the District Engineering Office.

steps.title: Read Claude's check and confirm its points against the sources
Verify the risk: Project cost and cost anomalies
sub: Check the stated length against the plans or Bill of Quantities; a wrong length distorts price per km.
Look for items that raise cost but are not road surface: drainage, slope protection, bridges, lighting.
Compare unit prices for the main items (concrete, asphalt) with similar contracts nearby.

steps.title: Verify the risk: Contractor history and performance
sub: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

steps.title: Check site and field evidence
sub: Check the site before work starts: satellite imagery of the stretch, earlier contracts on the same road, and whether a local monitor (Bisto Proyekto, a TPM civil-society partner) can take geotagged photos later.

steps.title: Write down what you found and keep the documents you relied on
sub: Screenshots, Bill of Quantities pages, photos or letters: attach them with your decision.
